description: Read `GET /v1/acl/list_org` as an `{ objects }` page. The spec declares a bare array of ACLs, but observed live 2026-11-12 the response is `{"objects":[{"id":...,"object_type":"dataset",...}]}`, the same envelope as `GET /v1/acl`, so the bare-array reading returned the wrapper object as if it were the list. With the items addressable, the operation pages by keyset like every other list: it takes `limit` and `starting_after`, and the next page starts after the last ACL's `id`.
